messages:
zara: opened PR to add Python SDK example for programmatic fallback routing + update migration guide links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

mike: paste the SDK snippet? quick inline review.

zara: pasted:

```python
from redwood import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
policy = {
  'trigger': {'metric':'p99_latency_ms','threshold_ms':180},
  'actions':[{'route_to':'dedicated-eu-fallback'},{'set_rate_limit':'10rps'},{'reduced_variant':'redwood/gpt-small-quant'}]
}
# runtime will run a compatibility_check when compatibility_check=True
client.provision.fallback_policy(tenant_id='t-123', policy=policy, compatibility_check=True)
```

eli: runtime nit: ensure snippet uses `threshold_ms` and include `compatibility_check=True` param so runtime enforces tool/schema check. Also add a short note to migration guide about KV cache warmup after switching variants.

zara: good call, will update and fix two broken links in migration guide that pointed to old CLI commands.

docs-bot: link-check: docs/dedicated/migration.md lines 45-46: /cli/fallback deprecated -> suggest /sdk/fallback.

mike: lgtm after compatibility_check added. Can you also add a one-line note about KV cache warmup?

zara: will push update, thanks.
